## Notes

- Off-Map Land Unit Movement Distance Chart (SPI 8.89): stages of continuous movement a unit needs between the Tunis, Gabes, Tripoli and Tripolitania boxes and Nofilia on map A, by its CPA: 25 or more / 15 to 20 / under 15 (the chart's own bands; 21-24 is not covered, kept as printed). A unit may not exceed its basic CPA while off-map. One row per unordered pair, stored with a < b
- The chart is on a page of the rulebook (jp2 70, with 36.53, 37.4 and 56.26), not the chart sheet. Transcribed from the archive.org scan and cross-checked against the community's OCR-converted scan of the same rulebook (scan:discord:CampaignNorthAfrica - converted.pdf:p71): 0 of 10 cells differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no charts
